# Internacia Datasets

> Machine-friendly reference data for countries, intergovernmental organizations (intblocks),
> and organization block types. Part of the Dateno open-source project.
> Licensed CC-BY-4.0 (data and documentation). Code is MIT.
> Version and schema: see data/datasets/*.manifest.json
> 中文索引: llms.zh.txt

## What this is

- **Countries** (256 records): ISO codes, geography, demographics, World Bank classifications, Wikidata links, multilingual names, stable attributes (`car_side`, writing systems/directions, DVD region, broadcast/legal systems, rail gauges)
- **Intblocks** (1500+ records): UN agencies, trade blocs, regional orgs, treaties, sports federations, named geographic groupings, etc.
- **Blocktypes** (83 records): taxonomy for intblock categories

This is **reference data for joins and enrichment**, not a socioeconomic profile dataset.
Do NOT expect HDI, GDP, government type, internet penetration, or similar indicators here.

## Preferred access (do not parse source YAML unless editing)

- DuckDB: data/datasets/internacia.duckdb (generated, not committed: run `python scripts/builder.py build` or download from the latest GitHub Release)
  - Tables: countries, intblocks, blocktypes, memberships, _meta, intblocks_aliases, countries_aliases, attribute_intblock_migrations, border_status, trade_agreements, trade_agreement_parties
  - Views: current_memberships, country_currencies, country_languages, country_timezones (see docs/data-contract.md)
- Parquet: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.parquet
- Membership edges (flattened): data/datasets/memberships.parquet / memberships.csv.zst / DuckDB table memberships
  - Columns: intblock_id, country_code, include_type, status, joined, left
- Plain JSONL: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.jsonl
- Compressed JSONL: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.jsonl.zst (decompress with zstd -d)
- Python SDK: https://github.com/datenoio/internacia-python (internacia 0.2.x on PyPI predates data v3; see SDK status below)
- REST API: https://github.com/datenoio/internacia-api (in development; self-host only; no public hosted instance; no installable release yet)

## Python SDK status

internacia 0.2.x (the current PyPI release) is broken on data v3: InternaciaClient() cannot
download data (it queries the old commondataio/internacia-db repository and gets 404),
search.fuzzy fails, get_by_member also returns former memberships, and get_by_id does not
resolve retired IDs. Until SDK 0.3.0 ships, prefer DuckDB SQL. SQL equivalents for every
SDK call: docs/llm-scenarios.md (section "SDK status").

With internacia.duckdb downloaded from a GitHub Release, basic lookups still work:

```python
from pathlib import Path
from internacia import InternaciaClient

client = InternaciaClient(db_path=Path("internacia.duckdb"))

country = client.countries.get_by_code("US")
print(country["name"])
```


## Schemas and metadata

- JSON Schema (source YAML): data/schemas/countries.schema.json, data/schemas/intblocks.schema.json
  - Each property includes a description field for agents and tooling
- Build manifests: data/datasets/countries.manifest.json, intblocks.manifest.json, blocktypes.manifest.json
  - Fields: version, build_date, git_commit, row_count, schema_hash, data_license, contract_version, files (sha256, bytes)
- Consumer contract: data/datasets/contract.json (tables, columns, keys, open enums, contract_version, min_duckdb); checksums: data/datasets/SHA256SUMS
- Parquet sidecars: data/datasets/{countries,intblocks,blocktypes}.meta.json
- ID remaps: data/datasets/intblocks_aliases.json (and .parquet)
- Country code remaps: data/datasets/countries_aliases.json
- Attribute intblock retirements → country fields: data/datasets/attribute_intblock_migrations.json
- Tool schemas: generated by the internacia SDK (internacia.tools.openai_tools, SDK 0.4+); data/schemas/*_lookup.openai.json are deprecated
- Data dictionary: docs/data-dictionary.md
- Getting started: docs/getting-started.md

## Token budgets (approximate)

| Artifact | ~Tokens | Use |
|----------|--------:|-----|
| llms.txt (this file) | ~1.5k | Always load first |
| countries-lite.parquet (~12 cols × 256) | ~8–15k | Entity linking |
| intblocks-lite.parquet | ~40–80k | Org discovery |
| Full countries.jsonl | large | Avoid in-context; query DuckDB |
| Full intblocks with includes | very large | Prefer memberships table + filters |

Prefer DuckDB SQL or lite Parquet over stuffing full JSONL into the prompt.

Check schema_hash before upgrading downstream pipelines. Breaking changes are in CHANGELOG.md.

## Join keys

- Countries: code (ISO alpha-2, primary), iso3code (alpha-3), numeric_code, wikidata_id (Q-number)
- Intblocks: id (uppercase string, e.g. EU, NATO, UN)
- Intblock membership: includes[].id → country code (authoritative); includes[].name is a display label only
- Departure dates: includes[].left and memberships.left (DuckDB/Parquet/JSONL)
- Intblock taxonomy: blocktype (list of blocktype keys), partof (parent org ids)
- Blocktypes: id matches intblocks.blocktype values

## Critical gotchas

- borders uses ISO alpha-3 codes, NOT alpha-2
- population, area, gini are structs: {value, year, source, source_id} — use .value for the number
- Current ISO countries only (249): filter code_status == 'official_iso3166_1'
- 7 non-standard country codes retained with explicit status: AN, JG, XK, XA, XS, XT, XN (Kosovo is XK; legacy KV in countries_aliases.json)
- Country code remaps: data/datasets/countries_aliases.json
- World Bank region/incomeLevel/lendingType missing for 8 entities (territories WB does not classify); adminregion missing for 119 records (those 8 plus 111 high-income economies) by design
- Bank-published classifications have provenance source 'World Bank'; 31 entities the Bank does not classify carry inferred values ('UN M49 inference' or 'World Bank (historical classification)')
- Filter World Bank region on region.id (e.g. 'ECS'), not region.value: the Bank renames regions (MEA became 'Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan' in 2025)
- Intblock id renames: consult intblocks_aliases.json; reason=disambiguated means old id now refers to a different entity
- Attribute partitions (traffic hand, DVD region, scripts, legal/broadcast systems, rail gauges) are country fields — not intblocks; remap retired ids via attribute_intblock_migrations.json
- Driving side: filter countries.car_side ('left'|'right'); do not join traffichand intblocks (retired)
- scope_category filters entity kind: igo | treaty_body | policy_forum | reference_enumeration (named sets) | intergovernmental_body (dependent commission/fund/office) | non_state_organization (NGO/association). The category does not imply country membership; filter includes[].status explicitly (see docs/intblock-inclusion-policy.md).
- institutional_design (optional, reviewed pilot cohort): mandate, decision_rule, decision_force, independent_organs[], enforcement[], mutual_defence, veto_holders[] of the principal organ; absent = unknown, [none] = none. Values: data/schemas/institutional_design.yaml. It measures authority, not influence; GDP and military capacity are not shipped (join external data on countries.iso3code). Recipes: docs/query-examples.md#authority-and-capacity
- Transit: includes[].role (origin|transit|destination on gaspipeline/oilpipeline records; terminal|transit on corridor records; also memberships.role) and border_status (closed|restricted land borders with since/until and sources; view country_borders). NULL status = no closure recorded, not verified open. Recipe: docs/query-examples.md#transit-and-borders. Trade volumes are not shipped.
- Trade agreements: trade_agreements (every FTA/PTA/customs union, bilateral included; status, dates, wto_rta_id, aric_id, gptad_id, links incl. treaty_text, verification official|catalogue), trade_agreement_parties, view country_trade_agreements (bloc parties such as EU expanded to current members, column via). Two-party FTAs left intblocks in 5.0.0: intblocks_aliases reason moved, target_dataset trade_agreements. Agreements with 3+ parties are also intblocks (trade_agreements.intblock_id).
- timezones: empty for uninhabited territories; timezone_status may be 'not_applicable'

## Example queries (DuckDB)

SELECT dataset, version, schema_hash FROM _meta;

SELECT code, name FROM countries WHERE un_member = true;

SELECT code, name FROM countries WHERE code_status = 'official_iso3166_1';

SELECT code, name FROM countries WHERE car_side = 'left' ORDER BY code;

SELECT n.code, n.name FROM countries th, UNNEST(th.borders) AS b(iso3) JOIN countries n ON n.iso3code = b.iso3 WHERE th.code = 'TH';

SELECT i.id, i.name FROM intblocks i, UNNEST(i.includes) AS t(m) WHERE m.id = 'LA' AND m.type = 'country' LIMIT 10;

SELECT intblock_id FROM memberships WHERE country_code = 'LA' AND status = 'member' LIMIT 10;

SELECT id, name FROM intblocks WHERE scope_category = 'igo' LIMIT 10;  -- IGOs; blocktype is the domain (e.g. 'fisheries')
